newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ICICI completes $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: India's ICICI completes $50 mln loan.

text.p: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India Ltd (ICIC) on Wednesday said it completed a $50.0 million syndicated loan facility.
"The facility will be utilised for prepaying an existing high-cost loan availed of by the erstwhile SCICI Ltd in March 1996," ICICI said in a statement.

The refinancing facility has a maturity of six years which is comparable with the remaining maturity of the existing high-cost loan and has a margin of 0.575 percent over LIBOR, representing a saving of over 50 basis points per annum over the existing loan.
The facility was arranged by ANZ Investment Bank, it said.
